title: GAS effect tick
summary: A timer by event calls a dispatcher when an effect should be heard.
when_to_use: Use this when a Gameplay Ability System effect should notify listeners without Tick.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is to apply the effect on the client, or to call the dispatcher every frame.

nodes.note: Begin Play binds the dispatcher and starts the timer once.
Bind Event Dispatcher so the UI can listen.
Set Timer by Event calls Apply Effect.
The ability system would apply the effect here.
Call Event Dispatcher when the effect lands.
